full: Why can a free sample sell what a perfect ad can't? An ad asks you to believe a sample lets you check. In a 1983 study, opinions from trying predicted buying better than opinions from ads. Field tests found samples brought in new buyers with effects up to a year later. Results varied widely between brands. So if one taste proves it, let people try.
